observations: Photo 0 shows a white industrial sewing machine on a pink table with a foot pedal and a blue tray under the table.
Photo 1 shows the same setup from a slightly different angle, with the machine head visible and a control panel on the right side.
Photo 2 is similar to photo 1, showing the machine head and control panel.
The machine appears to be a heavy-duty industrial model, likely for commercial or professional use.
The table has a pink top and white metal frame with blue casters.
The foot pedal is connected to the machine via a cable.
The machine head is beige or off-white, with visible needle, presser foot, and motor housing.
No brand or model name is visible on the machine head or table in any photo.
The seller claims it is 'Japanese made' and '290k pH' (likely a typo for '290k' as in 290,000 Naira).

claims.claim: Industrial Sewing Machine for immediate delivery.
claims.evidence: The machine's size, design, and setup (foot pedal, table, industrial components) confirm it is an industrial sewing machine. The photos show a heavy-duty machine suitable for commercial use.
The amount '290k' is likely a typo for '290,000 Naira', but 'pH' is not a standard term for pricing. No proof of price is visible in the photos.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine operating, including the motor running and needle moving.

risks.risk: The machine may be missing essential parts (e.g., power cord, accessories, manual).
risks.proof: A photo showing all included components laid out, including the power cord, foot pedal, and any accessories.

risks.risk: The machine may have been damaged or used heavily, affecting its lifespan or performance.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the needle, presser foot, motor housing, and internal components to check for wear or damage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used with unknown condition

proof_requests: Video of the machine operating to confirm functionality.
Photo showing all included parts and accessories.
Close-up photos of the needle, presser foot, and motor housing to check for damage or wear.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
